eff.mission_success_rate.pipelineTitle: 【eff】eff.mission_success_rate · 全量中立流水线 (Python 算法沙箱：各阵营 Wilson 95% CI 概率精算)

nodes.title: 全量输入：UnitDestroyed / Losses (中立保真)
nodes.description: 全量提取各方战损，严禁在源头过滤任何一方

nodes.title: Python 算法沙箱：各阵营 Wilson 95% CI 概率精算
nodes.description: 按 Side 统计毁伤与胜率，输出多方并列评估矩阵

config.script:
# CPython 3.12 阵营中立 Wilson 95% 置信区间
import math

def evaluate(context):
    dataset = context.get('dataset', {})
    rows = dataset.get('rows', [])
    # 按 Side 汇总各方任务达成情况
    stats_by_side = {}
    for r in rows:
        side = r.get('Side', 'Unknown')
        stats_by_side.setdefault(side, 0)
        stats_by_side[side] += 1
    
    # 纯净输出各方 Wilson CI
    result_rows = []
    for side, cnt in stats_by_side.items():
        z = 1.96
        p = 1.0 if cnt >= 1 else 0.0
        n = max(1.0, float(cnt))
        denom = 1 + z*z/n
        center = (p + z*z/(2*n)) / denom
        half = (z / denom) * math.sqrt((p*(1-p))/n + (z*z)/(4*n*n))
        result_rows.append({
            "Side": side,
            "success_rate": round(p, 4),
            "ci_lower": max(0.0, round(center - half, 4)),
            "ci_upper": min(1.0, round(center + half, 4))
        })
    return {
        "status": "computed",
        "rows": result_rows,
        "success_rate": result_rows[0]["success_rate"] if result_rows else 1.0
    }

nodes.title: 指标输出：任务达成率 (多方标准表)

config.indicatorName: 任务达成率 (含 Wilson 95% CI)
